title: rpt scope record
description: One in-scope asset, a row of scope.csv. Schema version 2. Other CSV columns appear as extra string members; no column may be named kind or lines.

rev.description: The row's revision, over scope.csv's header and the row's own text: edits to other rows leave it alone. Opaque: compare it, never compute it. Pass it back as --if-rev so a write is refused if the row changed since this read.

lines.description: Where the row sits in scope.csv. Given by rpt scope --lines; rpt scope add ignores it.

row.description: The 1-based line of scope.csv the row starts on. A quoted field can span lines, and blank lines are skipped, so count from here, not from the row's position.

file.description: Absolute path of scope.csv, in the form rpt opened the report by, symlinks not resolved.
